name: wiser-method-finance
description: This plugin computes a person's federal quarterly estimated tax and federal total tax for 2025 or 2026 by a locally installed engine for a filer inside the profile Tax Intake asks about, refuses Colorado, every other state, every other year, and the annualized installment method by name, installs @invaro/opentax only with the person's consent, and does not replace a licensed CPA, enrolled agent, or other tax professional, and does not hold itself out as one.
